he first two RWX runs failed in reflex-export. Reflex’s own bun download from GitHub returned 504 on the runner. I fixed it by adding a bun-install task to .rwx/preview.yml, copied from frontend.yml. It installs bun v1.4.3 from bun.sh with the checksum check, and reflex-export now depends on it.
Because reflex-export now uses that task, it is no longer byte-identical to reflex-build.yml. The comment at the top of preview.yml says to keep them in step so RWX can reuse the cache. reflex-build.yml will likely hit the same 504, so you may want the same fix there.
.rwx/preview.yml is modified and uncommitted. The preview ran from a patch of the working tree, so nothing was pushed or committed. rwx lint still warns that git/clone 2.2.0 is outdated (2.4.0 is current); I left it.

content.text:
I created three GitHub issues:

- **#57:** `reflex-build.yml` likely hits the same bun 504 as the preview run. It proposes adding the `bun-install` task there.
- **#58:** `reflex-export` in `preview.yml` no longer matches `reflex-build.yml`, which breaks the cache reuse the header comment asks for. It notes the `preview.yml` change is still uncommitted.
- **#59:** Bump `git/clone` from 2.2.0 to 2.4.0. I checked, and all eight pipelines in `.rwx/` use 2.2.0, so the issue lists all of them.

Your message ended at "create github issues for", so I picked these three from the notes you included. If you wanted a separate issue for the original 504 failure, or a different split, tell me.
